quote: Large channel 1 and channel 4 weights suggest moving things matter and their motion is tracked, which argues against a static maze or pure food-collection game.
judge_notes: Argues its answer from W1 patterns it claims to see (large channel 1/4 weights, opposite-signed channel 2/3 weights at cell (1,1)) plus the up bias, and says some options are ruled out 'with moderate confidence'. 'Low-confidence guess' alone is not enough. Flag set true because it says it 'could not read a clean per-cell spatial map' and 'The weights are too noisy to rule out other dodge-and-collect games' ('noisy' read as noise-like). The flag and the class point different ways because the reply both says the weights are noisy and argues from them.
